solution.concept: According to NCERT Class 12 Mathematics, a matrix $A$ is symmetric if $A' = A$ and skew-symmetric if $A' = -A$. A zero (null) matrix of order $n$ satisfies both $0' = 0$ and $0' = -0$, meaning it is both symmetric and skew-symmetric. A unit (identity) matrix $I$ satisfies $I' = I$, so it is always symmetric.
